mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400 and GDP growth (GDPC1) above 20000 over the prior 3 months signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1400 and GDPC1 > 20000, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment cycle (UNRATE < 3.5%), labor market tightness fuels wage growth and consumer spending, supporting corporate profit margins and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during UNRATE < 3.5% periods, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals robust manufacturing output, which elevates corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment exceeds 4.0%, it indicates labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS above 4.0 and CPIAUCSL above 295 signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 295, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong retail sales expansion (RSAFS > 680000), consumer spending growth directly supports corporate revenue and profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during RSAFS > 680000 periods, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.05.
